title: Element — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Element.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Smart Basics." Value tier. Element is Mideas entry-level North American brand — basic appliances at budget pricing available at big-box retailers.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Element:

• Midea manufacturing quality at entry pricing

• Available at major retailers

• Basic reliable functionality

• Smart features at budget prices

• Growing product range
